description: Spec §2.4 + example: when a newly-created script is activated via onSuccessActivateScript, isActive:true MUST appear in the created[id] entry. Implementation shows isActive:false in created and isActive:true in updated. Fix: after activation succeeds, patch created[creation_id][isActive]=true and remove from updated.
title: sieve_set: activated-on-create isActive:true not shown in created map
